  <hbox class="titlebar-buttonbox titlebar-color">
    <toolbarbutton class="titlebar-button titlebar-min"
                   titlebar-btn="min"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted unified-toolbar rule stretches .titlebar-buttonbox-container on Windows or Linux while retaining its fixed flex behavior. The explicit media-query or combines platforms; the containing toolbar also handles reversed GTK placement. This is the checked container/layout pattern, not a global rule to stretch every titlebar control. Native controls, RTL placement and window dragging were not exercised. This is static source and test-code inspection. Complete Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline context remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.
title: Keep toolbar platform media conditions scoped to the control container
